cases: Prepared cancellation blocks dispatch without invoking backend
Child revoke is visible in shared parent snapshot and waits for actual acknowledgement
Timeout retains unknown active work; independent root remains usable; late proof cannot unfreeze fault
Cancelled CompletableFuture is not external stop evidence
Parent cascade requests child/grandchild cancellation; each acknowledgement independent
Runtime shutdown marks pending receipt unknown even after owner session closed
Worker-only completion is partial; exporting external history is explicitly rejected

limitations: Registry/acknowledgements local to one JVM; no coordinator-wide receipt aggregation or persistence yet
Source task with any external record refuses export: external_execution_delegation_unsupported; prevents silent history loss until remote bridge exists
Remote SDK lease failure can trigger its local callbacks but source cannot claim all remote work stopped
No automatic Provider HTTP termination receipt or billing reconciliation
No model/token refund, side-effect rollback or compensation implied by stop acknowledgement
Host callback is trusted evidence and must return promptly; arbitrary stuck Java code cannot be forcibly stopped
DIRECT_PROCESS does not prove entire descendant tree; sandbox worker-only evidence does not raise platform guarantee
